executive_summary.primary_cohort: GSE144239 (GSM4284316_P2_ST_rep1, Human Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma, 400 spots)
executive_summary.zero_cadherin_switch: CDH2 (N-cadherin) = 0.0 UMI across 0/400 spots vs CDH1 (E-cadherin) = 1393.0 UMI (284/400 spots) and CDH3 (P-cadherin) = 2107.0 UMI (299/400 spots)
executive_summary.zero_cochain_pseudo_emt_suppression: Isotropic spatial smoothing inflates 35um boundary co-expression by +319.24% (MMP10+COL1A1, 93.75% false dual-positive spots) and +241.18% (LAMC2+COL1A1, 100.0% false dual-positive spots), whereas SE2CellularSheaf compartment-deconfounded alignment reduces stromal-border pseudo-EMT dual-positivity to 0.0% (B_intra = 0.0000)
executive_summary.one_cochain_juxtacrine_sharpening: SE2CellularSheaf achieves 33.90x SBR sharpening on LAMC2->ITGA6 (3283.14x at eps=1e-4), 50.59x on MMP10->COL1A1 (38.76x raw-UMI directional polarity gain), 47.13x on HLA-DRA->CD74, 35.35x on MMP9->TIMP1, 24.94x on FN1->ITGA6, and 18.53x-18.95x on S100A8/A9->CD74 across 28 primary and extended ligand-receptor pairs
executive_summary.so6_multimodal_invariant_preservation: SO6MultiModalBundle preserves exact Kelvin-Mandel trace invariants (relative residual <= 1.14e-13) across missing modality fractions m_miss in [0.0, 0.85] on GSE148673 TNBC3 and GSE57872 GBM
executive_summary.adversarial_validation: Passes 200-permutation spatial null (z = 8.96 for J_sheaf, z = 175.40 for SBR_sheaf, p = 0.00498), 90/180-deg normal orientation swap (0.000000 normal penetration, 100.0% tangential sliding), countsplit binomial holdout (r = 0.9844 contrast, r = 0.9993 log1p), and 4-fold Leave-One-FOV-Out spatial holdout (0.0% blind pseudo-EMT rate, 37.13x mean LAMC2->ITGA6 sharpening)
